Original SkillInfoManager.IsValidSkillID MethodDef 0x06001163 is complete 21-byte tiny-header IL SHA 9fe678f08e9083c8b36482f038cd33969c3d78bfb5ea3cc4c47db02cf9b01992: it loads the same field and its first argument, invokes ContainsKey MemberRef 0x0A000752, then returns numeric Boolean 1 for true / 0 for false through a long brfalse target 19. Three original callvirt instructions to IsValidSkillID are present in SkillDataMan._loadPackedSkillData IL+91/141/201; another in SkillDataMan_Craft.InitSkillData IL+1941. No original authored key entries, collection counts or actual gameplay outcomes proven.
